prompts.task: Use $otel-audit ./service. Also assess each independent source case in eval/inputs/agent-resource-cases.json and save a supplemental .observe/agent-resource-cases.json with its source-owned role, producer/destination choice, project/stream/routing assessment and remaining proof. Keep the actual service canonical audit and HTML distinct from those source cases. Remain read-only for application source, configuration, dependencies and tests; no models, cloud, resource provisioning, browser or UI actions. Do not reuse old classifications without inspecting source. No resource names, library choices or destination changes are supplied by this request. Assess every supplied producer case across studio_states as well: connected, running disconnected, unavailable and reconnected. Separate proposed capability from actual proof. Galileo/direct destinations remain independent. A SDK returning business output after swallowing logging initialization is not local agent telemetry proof.

judge_inputs: Inspect original actual app source, each independent source case, canonical audit/HTML, supplemental JSON and actor commands. Merely repeating a policy table is not source-bound assessment.
rubric: Recognizes actual SmashBot model-directed behavior and preserves existing native OTel ownership. Even without an explicit AO request, authors separate default project, dedicated stream and runtime-routing configuration findings in canonical findings, with matching readiness/evidence, dependency closure, SDK-free resource resolution and loaded-profile/header acceptance. Existing OTel, missing SDK/imports, missing names or cloud credentials never make those requirements out of scope.

Separately assesses fresh_ao, existing_ao and fresh_native_fallback: fresh compatible SDK choice uses supported AO creators and default resource/routing work; existing AO keeps its creator and native resource/export path; Go fallback uses native OTel plus SDK-free resources/routing rather than dropping project/stream, inventing a SDK or adding a Python sidecar. Separates proposed/current support evidence from unavailable installed proof.

For native_otel, preserves existing producer/provider/exporter and endpoint/protocol, plans resource-before-export and actual loaded trace-specific projectid/logstreamid headers for Studio, distinguishes destination-specific standalone headers, and does not install splunk-ao or add duplicate export. Identifies any explicit incompatible destination as a scoped decision rather than silently replacing it.

For galileo and galileo_plus_native, retains Galileo-native resource clients and consumed GALILEO selectors/constructor configuration plus native export; production stream survives. Plans supported native lookup/create/reuse/association and actual SDK export proof without replacing vendor clients with the AO helper, requiring SPLUNK_AO settings, forcing Studio headers or installing splunk-ao. Mixed case also preserves the independent OTLP destination and rules out duplicate logical spans/exports.

Plans ordered idempotent project/stream lookup/create/reuse, IDs as lookup-only, ownership and association, repeat/conflict/uncertain-create recovery, source-consumed profile/configuration and truthful failure isolation. Separates resource resolution, native/local export and exact fresh destination trace visibility; no source/example/acknowledgement is cloud proof.

Does not impose agent resource adoption on non_agent_control or create duplicate workflow/agent boundaries; source cases remain separate from live findings. Canonical JSON/HTML remain valid and source/config/tests remain unchanged. Every table row has an evidence-backed decision or exact unavailable-proof reason, not a blanket Pass.

Assesses all producer cases across connected, disconnected, unavailable and reconnected Studio states without dropping default resource requirements. Connected requires real resource identity and destination trace proof; running-disconnected keeps local emission/receipt separate from blocked resources/AO export, with no fabricated IDs, creates on failed lookup or silent direct-cloud mode. Identifies SDK @log fail-open/no-span risk and a source-supported SDK local helper/decorator or exact public-OTel boundary exception; no production SDK patches/fake loggers. Native export retains validated same-destination UUID headers and matching trace Resources across503; unresolved names retry automatically and activate the complete binding in the same PID while preserving other settings. Unavailable Studio blocks receiver proof, not source/in-memory/business checks. Galileo remains native/independent; recovery revalidates active bindings with zero duplicate creates and one producer/export per operation.
